newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's PMI index rises to 58 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's PMI index rises to 58 pct in March.

text.p: Hungary's Purchasing Manager Index (PMI) was 58 percent in April, up from 55.1 percent in March, the Hungarian Association of Logistics, Purchasing and Inventory Management (HALPIM) said on Monday.
The following is a history of the index over the year on a month-to-month basis:

NOTE: The PMI is calculated using the same methodology as the United States' National Association of Purchasing Management Index. A figure above 50 indicates increasing economic activity, while a number below 50 shows declining economic activity.
The 58 percent vigure for April indicates that activity in the processing industry continued to increase substantially, the HALPIM said.
